definitions.gloss: reading carefully; reading thoroughly; close reading
definitions.explanation: Reading something attentively and carefully to fully understand its content, as opposed to skimming or casual reading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熟読|じゅくどく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熟読|じゅくどく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てた→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧。
examples.english: I assembled it after reading the instructions thoroughly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{熟読|じゅくどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This book is worth reading carefully many times.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word emphasizing careful, attentive reading. Often used in instructions telling the reader to read something thoroughly before proceeding. The {熟|じゅく} character conveys the meaning of "thorough" or "mature."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熟読|じゅくどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to read carefully)
- {熟読|じゅくどく}{玩味|がんみ} (reading and savoring — a set phrase for deep appreciation)
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{熟読|じゅくどく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (please read ~ carefully)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{速読|そくどく}→速読：22402_sokudoku⟧: speed reading — reading quickly, the opposite approach
- ⟦{拾|ひろ}い{読|よ}み→拾い読み：17927_hiroiyomi⟧: skimming, selective reading — only reading parts
- ⟦{通読|つうどく}→通読：19800_tsuudoku⟧: reading through — reading from start to finish without deep analysis
- ⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧: close reading — very similar, slightly more academic
